media:group.media:title: I Built the Smartest Trap in Rust Using An Exploit...
media:group.media:description:
I Built the Smartest Trap in Rust… and it completely changed how I get loot.
Instead of risking fights, roaming, or getting countered I built a trap that secretly sends loot straight back to my base. No running. No risk. Just free loot… delivered.
But pulling this off wasn’t easy.

So I set it up, waited… and one by one, players started walking straight into it.
And that’s when things got interesting.

media:group.media:title: I Built A Hidden Trap That Sends Loot To My Base...
media:group.media:description:
Get 5% Off PropBuilds: https://bit.ly/PropOblivion Follow MyInstagram: https://www.instagram.com/oblivionreal Follow Lones Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/sometimeslone
Bushes in Rust are good for two things… hiding when you need a break and ruining someone’s day.
So I turned one into a trap.
I placed a broken-looking box inside a bush, surrounded it with snap traps, and added a hidden hopper system that sucks bodies and loot straight into my base.
Players think they’ve found free loot… but the second they step in, it’s already over.
This might be one of the most efficient (and evil) traps I’ve ever built.

entry.title: I Built A Trap That Locks Players In And Hides The Bodies...

media:group.media:title: I Built A Trap That Locks Players In And Hides The Bodies...
media:group.media:description:
I built the most innocent looking shelter in Rust… but it’s actually a full trap base.
From the outside, it looks like a basic noob starter. Nothing suspicious. Just a small shelter with an open door.
But the second someone steps inside… it’s over.
A hidden door slams shut behind them, trapping them inside while Tesla coils instantly fry them. And before anyone can even react, a secret hopper system pulls all their loot straight into a hidden box.
They never even get a chance.
This is one of the cleanest and most satisfying trap bases I’ve ever built… and people fall for it EVERY time.
